news.text: 🇵🇱🤔 #Milik is convincing #Spalletti during the pre-season preparation. The feedback is positive, although more time will be needed to understand if he can guarantee consistency. His characteristics match the coach's request. The decision on his future will also be important for the mercato: neither #KoloMuani nor #Zirkzee have what the manager requires, so the Pole can become the wild card.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

While #PSG attempts to close the deal for #Suzuki, #Juve is contacting #Trubin's entourage: in these hours, new contact with #Benfica.The Lusitanian club's request to the agents: 50 mln.#Juventus continues to have a maximum budget of 40 mln for the goalkeeper (if he convinces; otherwise they will try to divert the investment elsewhere).[Dario Pellegrini]

🧐❗️"Regarding #Zirkzee, patience is needed and with a formula that does not include an immediate obligation to buy. #Juventus cannot spend any more money today, but they count on the player's desire as long as he continues to wait. On #Pellegrino, who is also followed by #Fiorentina, things have slowed down: #Parma wants a fairly simple obligation to buy, while the bianconeri want different formulas. Everything will depend on the Dutchman's patience."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇨🇴🆙 "After the expiration of the €28M clause, #Lucumí said 'no' to everyone because he is waiting for #Juventus, his priority. #Bologna, after having asked for €25M, has dropped to €20/21M, while the bianconeri are stuck at €17M + bonuses. The gap is about €3M and I think that with a bit of goodwill it can be bridged. The defender, meanwhile, continues to wait."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🔚 #DiGregorio is virtually placed on the outbound mercato, a transfer remains the choice most widely shared by the management. #Juventus has decided to sign another goalkeeper, while he would consider the option of staying to fight for his chances as a backup, but it is not his primary ambition. Together with the agent, he is evaluating the best solution: English clubs are currently the most interested, even though negotiations have not yet started.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🧤❌ "#Atubolu is not an invented name, but yesterday from the #Juventus side, they told me that he did not convince much as an option. It is not a track that excites. The bianconero club is taking all the time available to make a choice in that sector."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]
✅ "#Alajbegovic will be a starter tomorrow. I am not so sure about #KoloMuani."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

👀🔥 "I don't think today, but I sense a lively #Juventus in terms of signings. In my opinion, we need to start paying attention; when they move so quietly on multiple tracks, something always pops up."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]
From what they are telling me, #Juve continues to work decisively for #Trubin.He could be the name chosen at the photo finish in #Juventus's great race for the goal.[Edoardo Mecca]
